title: Orchestrate audit/report-only classifier
problem: Natural-language audit/report-only goals matched tnf-refactoring-triage including execute-safe-refactors and returned false SUCCESS without producing the named artifact.

solution.summary: Detect audit/report-only intent; refuse mutate workflow patterns; require named output path exists before SUCCESS.
steps: Locate executeGoal / pattern matcher in packages/tnf-cli/src/orchestration.ts (tnf-refactoring-triage already referenced ~L95); add intent class REPORT_ONLY when goal matches /\b(audit|report-only|report only|synthesis|what makes sense|full enchilada)\b/i.
If REPORT_ONLY, exclude patterns containing execute-safe-refactors, refactor, mutate, apply-fix unless goal also contains explicit 'implement'/'fix now'.
Route REPORT_ONLY to a workflow that: (a) gathers evidence commands, (b) writes/updates the path extracted from goal (docs/...md), (c) verifies file exists + non-empty before status=completed.
Add unit/fixture test: audit goal must not select tnf-refactoring-triage.
Log classifier decision into docs/operations/tnf-full-auto-runs.jsonl-compatible or orchestrator run log.
verify: tnf orchestrate --goal 'REPORT-ONLY audit: write docs/operations/audits/amendments/_orchestrate_smoke.md with one line ping' --no-splash
Negative: goal with audit must not schedule execute-safe-refactors (assert in orchestrator log/JSON)
solution.rollback: Env TNF_ORCHESTRATE_ALLOW_MUTATE_ON_AUDIT=1 restores old matching (debug only).

acceptance_probe: Audit goal never claims completed unless synthesis path exists; mutate tasks absent from planned steps.
